description: Declaration-only F5 behavior that states two dir-resolved pad groups on one device. The declaration normalizes two named groups; this host resolves one pad word, so it refuses the second group by name instead of running the first and dropping the second. Since 2026-11-03 (P2) the host executes up to four groups in declaration order; this file stays declaration-only evidence of the shape, and a second pad word is still refused by name.
notes: this is a schema example, not any pinned device's register map: no profile in configs/peripherals declares two independent pad words, so no scenario references this file

the two groups state different directions and hold times so the normalized form carries the direction/timing facts the group schema owns: group pads is an inout word held for 0 ticks, group strobes is an output word held for 4 ticks
the interrupt facts are the PULP GPIO ones so the file is a complete F5 declaration: the refusal is about the pad groups, not about a missing trigger or status word
